title: Quantitative Success Thresholds
description: States operationalized, numeric success criteria per work package (e.g. convergence rate bound, named benchmark with % accuracy or fairness gap target, evaluation-budget ratio against a named baseline), rather than qualitative outcomes like 'revised guarantees' or 'scalable methods'.

title: Avoids Menu-of-Techniques Padding
description: Avoids enumerating multiple existing methods in parentheticals (e.g. 'Lyapunov functions, saddle-point avoidance'; 'Lagrangian multipliers, penalty methods'; 'decision trees, attention mechanisms') without selecting one, justifying the choice, or specifying how it binds to the research step.
